architecture.canonical_artifacts: versioned Estimates in existing artifact persistence
architecture.context_broker: retrieval only; no pricing authority or source activation
architecture.external_provider: provider fetch occurs outside PostgreSQL transaction; exact observation is persisted and validated before calculation/commit
architecture.idempotency: same command identity and digest returns stored receipt; digest mismatch conflicts; unknown commit reconciled from persisted identity
architecture.transaction: atomic exact authorization/currentness, CAS version, approval decision, Audit Event and transactional outbox intent
architecture.workflow: reuse existing R2 WorkItem and single WorkflowRun

calculation.display_reconciliation: separate from tax-extraction residual; derive only after validated calculation from quantized display components and final quantized line; bounded by (m+1)*Q/2 where m is number of signed displayed components; exceed => TAX_RULE_UNRESOLVED
calculation.estimate_total: exact sum of final quantized line totals; no requantization
calculation.line_total_quantization: one ROUND_HALF_UP quantization per line, after tax and FX
operation_order: validate exact source, authority, revisions, PriceItem, UOM, currencies, pricing_as_of and policy bindings
gross_source=quantity*unit_price under pinned HALF_UP Decimal context
resolve exact TaxBasis and ordered component model
for-inclusive-lines extract pre-tax base and calculate audit-only extraction residual
prove gross is enclosed by directed-rounded tax recurrence interval
apply one approved discount to pre-tax base; recompute post-discount taxes
net_source=taxable_base+sum(post-discount tax components); never include extraction residual
apply exact approved FX conversion after tax
propagate interval through discount/tax/FX and require lower and upper final quantizations to be identical
quantize final line once; otherwise TAX_RULE_UNRESOLVED
quantize displayed components separately and compute bounded display-only reconciliation
sum quantized line totals exactly

residual.outcome: TAX_RULE_UNRESOLVED if equation not enclosed or final quantized amount is not unique
residual.usage: audit and validation only; never affects taxable_base, tax_i, net_source, FX amount, Estimate total or display reconciliation
residual.validation: directed interval arithmetic validates exact approved equation; no arbitrary allocation

calculation.rounding: ROUND_HALF_UP; context 34 significant digits; final line output once at approved .01 quantum

currency.quantum_authority: Finance decision F5 2026-11-07; runtime binding still required

decimal.estimate_total: exact sum of quantized line totals; no aggregate re-quantization
decimal.exceptional_traps_and_range_preflight: preserve original v1 semantics: InvalidOperation, DivisionByZero, Overflow, Underflow, Subnormal, Clamped, FloatOperation trapped; Inexact and Rounded signals permitted and rounded by context; preflight output coefficient width before quantization; range breach => CALCULATION_RANGE_EXCEEDED

input_constraints.unit_price: nonnegative; zero allowed only from an approved price source

decimal.input_precision: maximum 34 significant digits; exact decimal-string only; no float and no implicit rounding
decimal.input_scale_policy: source-specific, immutable versioned scale/domain policy required; missing source schema or policy blocks; invalid scale => ESTIMATE_INPUT_INVALID
decimal.intermediate_semantics: preserve accepted v1 Decimal context/traps; Inexact and Rounded signals are permitted and use the pinned ROUND_HALF_UP context; directed interval pass is validation only
decimal.line_quantization: once per final converted line total using ROUND_HALF_UP

discount.fixed_amount_limit_basis: equivalent percentage = fixed_discount / pre-tax base; zero base with positive fixed discount unresolved and blocked
discount.fixed_discount_equivalent_percentage: fixed_discount / pre_tax_base only when base > 0; no division when base is zero
discount.override: manual price override requires independent authorized approver; requester cannot self-approve; reason and evidence; prior/proposed amount; exact Estimate version and calculation digest; successor version and fresh approval after material change; never mutate source
discount.security_boundary: Finance policy does not grant application permissions or approve Security segregation controls

estimate_aggregation.display_reconciliation_bound_candidate: absolute(display_reconciliation) <= (m + 1) * Q/2; m counts displayed subtotal, discount and post-discount tax components only; extraction diagnostic is excluded; exceed => TAX_RULE_UNRESOLVED
estimate_aggregation.display_reconciliation_role: separate display rounding only after tax equation and unique final output validation; cannot correct formula inconsistency or include extraction diagnostic
estimate_aggregation.displayed_components: subtotal minus discount plus post-discount tax components; no pre-discount included tax or extraction diagnostic is included
estimate_aggregation.immutable_estimate: every material change creates successor version and exact-version reapproval; prior approval does not transfer
estimate_aggregation.rounding_adjustment: display-only reconciliation after successful interval uniqueness check; never includes tax extraction residual

estimate_lifecycle.approval_digest: exact Estimate version and calculation digest
estimate_lifecycle.approval_roles: Estimate Approver distinct from requester; discounts/overrides use approved thresholds and independent authorized approver
estimate_lifecycle.recalculation: successor Estimate; material changes require fresh approval
estimate_lifecycle.revoked_basis: previously approved but undelivered Estimate requires recalculation and reapproval
estimate_lifecycle.source_revocation: no new use; existing Estimate immutable; affected undelivered Estimate requires recalculation and reapproval
estimate_lifecycle.workflow: reuse existing R2 WorkItem/WorkflowRun; no independent pricing workflow

f9_t1_decision.block: TAX_RULE_UNRESOLVED when tax equation cannot be validated or quantized interval result is non-unique
f9_t1_decision.residual: diagnostic-only; not added to net_source or any commercial amount
f9_t1_decision.validation: directed interval arithmetic validates tax equation and unique final quantized amount

block_conditions: interval does not uniquely determine final currency-quantized monetary result
f9_t1_policy.interval_validation: approved directed-rounding interval validation of the tax equation
f9_t1_policy.residual: diagnostic and audit only; never contributes to net_source, taxes, taxable base, FX amount, Estimate total or displayed commercial amount

fx.actual_rate_observation: governed source data to onboard later; no online lookup or LLM rate
fx.authority: official Bank of Russia rates; actual observations are governed source data not supplied here
fx.authority_ref: finance-decision:F4:2026-11-07; governed source revision must be onboarded
fx.cross_currency_formula: FX(A->B) = (RUB per unit A) / (RUB per unit B)
fx.nominal_normalization: normalize official quotation nominal; use official unit rate where supplied or quoted amount divided by nominal
fx.non_business_days: use latest officially effective rate, not latest downloaded observation
fx.pair_policy: RUB against USD/EUR/CNY uses approved normalized Bank of Russia quotations; non-RUB cross rates are RUB-mediated; all observations share selected effective date
fx.pair_resolution_order: same currency identity; RUB pair uses normalized Bank of Russia observation; non-RUB pair uses RUB-mediated formula (RUB per unit A)/(RUB per unit B); all required observations share the same selected official effective date; missing or ambiguous => FX_RATE_UNAVAILABLE
fx.quote_date: pricing_as_of is YYYY-MM-DD business quote date
fx.rate_binding: exact observation SourceObject/SourceRevision/version/digest, currency, nominal-normalized unit rate, official effective date and Finance authority
fx.rate_date_selection: select latest officially effective Bank of Russia rate date <= pricing_as_of; for cross rates require each observation at that same selected official effective date; no downloaded_at selection
fx.same_currency: identity conversion; no external observation needed
fx.stage: after discount and tax, before final line quantization
fx.timezone: timestamp to quote-date conversion requires exact approved workspace IANA timezone; no default; missing binding => ESTIMATE_INPUT_INVALID

interval_validation.diagnostic: persist interval trace and extraction residual, but do not add residual to monetary calculation
interval_validation.directed_rounding: ROUND_FLOOR for lower bounds and ROUND_CEILING for upper bounds
interval_validation.divide: fail if denominator interval contains zero; minimum/maximum endpoint quotients rounded down/up
interval_validation.final_amount_uniqueness: propagate enclosure through approved discount, tax and FX DAG; quantize both final endpoints with ROUND_HALF_UP at currency quantum; require equal quantized outputs, else TAX_RULE_UNRESOLVED
interval_validation.inputs: exact validated decimal values as point intervals
interval_validation.multiply: minimum of four endpoint products rounded down; maximum rounded up
interval_validation.precision: 34 significant digits, Emin=-999999, Emax=999999, clamp=0, pinned traps
interval_validation.purpose: validate tax equation and unique final currency-quantized amount; does not replace commercial Decimal result
interval_validation.tax_equation_check: gross_source point must be within directed enclosure of base + ordered included tax recurrence

operation_order: validate exact approved PricingBasis, PriceItem, SourceRevision, scope, UOM, currency, pricing_as_of and policy bindings
compute gross_source using Decimal context
resolve explicit tax mode and ordered TaxBasis
extract inclusive pre-tax base and audit-only residual where applicable
directed interval validate inclusive equation
apply one approved discount and calculate post-discount tax components
calculate net_source without extraction residual
apply same-effective-date authorized FX with no intermediate quantization
propagate final amount interval and require unique quantized line amount
quantize line total once
derive separate bounded display reconciliation
sum quantized line totals exactly
line_calculation.source_final: taxable_base + sum(post-discount tax components); inclusive extraction residual is diagnostic only and is never included
line_calculation.unit_price_policy: unit_price >= 0; zero is eligible only when established by an approved pricing source

current AccessPolicy separately from pricing business authority
no self approval for discount, override, source publication or own Estimate
identity independence checked by canonical actor ID, not role label

serialization.decimal: finite-base-10-fixed-point-string; strip insignificant trailing zeroes; canonical zero is 0; no exponent notation
serialization.digest: SHA-256 over canonical payload bytes; exclude approval metadata and digest field
